summary: Resize the TUI sidebar by dragging its right border or using Ctrl+Left/Right while the sidebar is focused; double-click the border or use Ctrl+Home to reset

schema.detail: An optional sidebar_width preference is stored locally with the existing terminal UI preferences; no graph or storage schema change.

compatibility.detail: Older preference files and resets retain the original responsive default. Chosen widths are clamped to available space, reserving 82 columns when a terminal pane is open. A chosen width hides the sidebar when the terminal cannot fit both panes.

manual.detail: Drag the highlighted one-column right border to resize. Existing sidebar row dragging is unchanged. Keyboard shortcuts are listed in help.

recovery.detail: Reset the width with a border double-click or Ctrl+Home while the sidebar is focused. Earlier binaries ignore the optional preference.
